resources.string: No saved media yet — in GardePro: Select → Save
To show your photos and videos, allow this app access to photos and media.\n\nOpen Android Settings → Apps → Trail Cam Gallery → Permissions, and allow Photos/Media.

No photos or videos yet.

In the official GardePro app: tap Select, then Select All, then the save icon. It downloads the full-resolution photos and videos to this device (it never wakes the camera, so it uses no camera battery). Then come back here — they'll appear automatically.

Tap "Get new" to open GardePro.
